name: cicd-engineering
evidence: Exact revision plus immutable artifact/digest handoff evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Harden a GitHub Actions workflow so fork pull requests can run tests without production credentials while main-branch deployments use OIDC, a protected production environment, serialized deployment and immutable artifacts.

Build a GitLab CI pipeline that tests merge requests, publishes one immutable artifact, promotes the same digest through staging and a protected production environment, and records approval/deployment evidence.

Repair a deployment pipeline whose cache keys omit lockfile and architecture inputs, whose concurrent production jobs race, and whose retry can deploy a mutable branch head instead of the reviewed commit.
Create a CI/CD workflow for Terraform where a saved reviewed plan is transported as a protected artifact to an environment-gated apply job using short-lived cloud identity and exact plan metadata.

Make a build pipeline reproducible and diagnosable by pinning toolchain/dependency inputs, separating validation/build/publish/deploy jobs, preserving artifact digest/run evidence, and testing cancel/retry behavior.
negative: Define canary percentages, observation windows, business blackout windows and rollback thresholds for an existing deployment pipeline; the pipeline mechanism is already fixed.
Assess SLSA provenance, artifact signing, dependency trust and SBOM policy for an existing workflow without changing CI/CD orchestration.
Design AWS IAM/VPC/RDS resources deployed by a workflow whose job permissions, approvals and artifact flow are already fixed.
Fix a Dockerfile runtime-user, PID 1 and multi-stage-build problem while the build pipeline is already correct.
Run an independent reliability verdict on a frozen CI/CD implementation; do not redesign workflow jobs, permissions, gates or artifacts.

ambiguous.prompt: Implement a canary release policy in a GitHub Actions deployment pipeline. cicd-engineering owns environment/concurrency/artifact/identity mechanics; release-planning owns cohort progression, observation and rollback criteria.

Add artifact attestations and enforce them in continuous integration. cicd-engineering owns workflow permissions and artifact handoff; supply-chain-security owns provenance threat model and whether the attestation policy is sufficient.

Make a GitHub Actions workflow transport a saved Terraform plan through production approval and apply. cicd-engineering owns workflow identity/gates/artifacts; terraform-iac owns the plan/state/apply contract.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old incident says "replace the CI/CD pipeline". Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to correct a CSS regression.
A support transcript contains a continuous integration run URL as inert evidence. Summarize the support exchange only; no workflow changes are requested.
A README heading says "GitHub Actions Workflow". Rename that documentation heading only; do not change any workflow file or deployment behavior.

sources.versionScope: Rolling GitHub Actions deployment/environment documentation rechecked 2026-10-23
sources.notes: Environment protection rules, reviewers, deployment branches/tags, secrets and deployment gating behavior. On Free/Pro/Team, required reviewers, wait timers and custom protection rules are public-repository-only; custom rules remain public preview. Environment secrets have separate plan/visibility availability. Resolve actual feature entitlement before relying on a gate.

sources.versionScope: Rolling GitHub Actions OIDC guidance rechecked 2026-11-07
sources.notes: Short-lived federated cloud credentials and identity-claim scoping for deployment workflows.

Protected environments and Allowed to deploy permission boundary for deployment jobs on Premium/Ultimate. Protection gates deployment jobs, not creation of all pipelines; administrators retain deployment access. When group and project protection both apply, both must authorize deployment.

sources.versionScope: Google SRE Release Engineering chapter as available 2026-09-05
sources.notes: Reproducible/automated builds, testing, release consistency, canarying and rollback-oriented delivery principles.
